name: moonshift-mods
description: Claude Code mods for building Moonshift Studio apps: studio board, secret guard and the Moonshift skin.

plugins.name: studio-board
plugins.description: /studio opens a panel with every Moonshift app's status and links plus a studio to-do list; /todo adds to it.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude from writing secret keys into code or committing and pushing them, and keeps .env files out of git.

plugins.name: moonshift-skin
plugins.description: Moonshift look: night-shift spinner words, a gold shift-done line and the app you're working on in the footer.
